src.bungie:
With Blink equipped, use [Air Dodge]  while airborne to perform a Dark Blink.

Using Blink or Dark Blink grants Volatile Rounds. Blink travels farther, causes nearby targets to become volatile, and has a shorter cooldown. While your Nova Warp Super is active, Dark Blink does not cost Super energy. Provides a moderate benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.

Passive grants the following benefits:
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness
• 25% increased Blink distance
• 20% decreased Blink cooldown (3.55s⁠🠚⁠2.85s)
• 30% decreased Blink activation delay (1.65s⁠🠚⁠1.15s)
• Removes Super Energy cost of Nova Warp's Dark Blink
While Blink is equipped, gain a horizontal 'Dark Blink' bound to your [Air Move]. Movement is identical to Nova Warp's Dark Blink, which spawns 4 [2] Weakening Seekers that scale with the Super stat. Incurs a 6 [8] second cooldown on use.
Blinking or casting Dark Blink grants 100 Handling for 2 seconds, Volatile Rounds for 9 [5] seconds, and the Radar remains active during the animation.
Enemies within 10? meters become Volatile when initiating Blink.

Passively grants +30 Airborne Effectiveness and enhances Blink.
While Blink is equipped, either on Void or Prismatic Subclasses:
Grants a free horizontal Dark Blink usage with [Air Move] every 6 [8] seconds.
Dark Blink releases 4 [2] Seekers that are functionally identical to Nova Warp's and scale with Super Damage.
25% Increased Blink Distance.
20% Decreased Cooldown for Blink Charges. (3.55 -> 2.85 seconds for both charges)
Time between blinks is decreased by 30% (1.65 -> 1.15 seconds) 
On Blink/Dark Blink Activation:
Inflicts Volatile to enemies within 10 metres.
Grants Volatile Rounds for 9 [5] seconds.
+100 Handling for 2 seconds. Stowing cancels the effect.
Radar remains active.
During Nova Warp Super:
Dark Blink does not consume Super Energy.

src.bungie: Standing in a rift creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies and heal them. Standing in an empowering rift creates Noble Seekers that grant both you and your ally a damage bonus. When a Noble Seeker finds an ally, you gain class ability energy. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of the Hand Cannon Lumina.
src.clarity:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Lumina and Noble Seekers grant Noble Rounds to it.
Standing in a Rift or Well of Radiance creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies within 40 meters and apply buffs to them:
• Healing Rift Seeker: restores 70 Health, 60 Shields, and starts Health Regeneration
• Empowering Rift Seeker: grants 100 Class Stat and 35% [15%] increased damage for 5 seconds (Empowering Buff)
Noble seekers spawn at a constant rate based on your Fireteam size.
Buffing allies with Noble Seekers grants ?|25%|?|?|? Class Ability energy based when your fireteam has 2|3|4|5|6 members.
Seekers prioritize allies who have not been healed in the last 8 seconds followed by nearby allies. Seekers will not target an ally more than once every 4 seconds.

Passively grants +30 Airborne Effectiveness to Lumina. Noble Seekers grant Noble Rounds to Lumina.

Track allies within 40 metres and bestow a buff on close proximity.

src.bungie: Your Void Souls have a longer duration. They also gain escalating damage and durability as they defeat targets. You can retrieve your Void Souls by interacting with them, allowing them to be redeployed.
src.clarity:
Void Souls last 5 seconds longer and can be retrieved by interacting with them. Retrieving them grants 'Void Soul Ready' for 25 seconds, allowing it to be redeployed while keeping its Kill Bonuses.
Void Soul Kills permanently increase their damage and Damage Resistance, maxing out after 4 Kills:
• 25%|50%|75%|100% increased Void Soul damage
• 12.5%|25%|37.5%|50% increased Void Soul Damage Resistance
While tethered to targets, Void Souls' damage ramps up to a 30% increase over 10 seconds. This damage bonus resets once no targets are tethered.
If multiple Void Souls tether the same enemy, they will each deal the damage of the first Soul to do so.

25% | 50% | 75% | 100% increased damage.
12.5% | 25% | 37.5% | 50% Damage Resist.

src.bungie: Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Trace Rifle's magazine from reserves. Damaging a vehicle, boss, or Champion with a Trace Rifle marks them as the target. When an ally defeats the marked target, Special ammo is generated for you and Heavy ammo for your allies.
src.clarity:
Refills 4% of the magazine of Trace Rifles (rounded up) from reserves every 0.7 seconds. Works even while stowed.
Rapidly scoring 5 Trace Rifle hits on a Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Vehicle marks them for you and allies for 10 seconds.
Additional hits refresh the mark duration. Does not require Direct Hits. Multiple people cannot mark the same enemy.
Only one target can be marked at a time and the mark cannot be transferred to a different target before the duration runs out or the enemy is defeated.
Ally kills on Marked Enemies spawn a Heavy Ammo Brick for allies and a Special Ammo Brick for you.
Spawned Ammo Bricks grant 10.33% of your total reserves (rounded up).
src.compendium:
Trace Rifles refill 4% of their Magazine every 0.7 seconds. 
Works while stowed.

Combatant is marked for 10 seconds.
Additional Trace Rifle Hits refresh the duration of the mark.
On Marked Enemy Death by Ally:
Generates Heavy Ammo for allies.
Generates Special Ammo for wearer.
Cenotaph Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

src.bungie:
Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super that deals damage and applies a matching elemental effect:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Weakens targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.
Elemental final blows temporarily increase the explosion's size. Precision final blows always maximum the explosion's size.
src.clarity:
Kinetic Weapon Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to 252 [100] elemental damage matching your equipped Super in a 4 meter radius. Precision Kills increase the radius to 8 meters.
Elemental Kills grant one stack of 'Crystalline Transitor' for 11 seconds. Maximum of 2 stacks. Stacks expire one at a time.
Crystalline Transitor increases the radius of the explosion to 6|8 Meters, at 1|2 stacks.
Enemies hit by the explosion receive an elemental debuff corresponding to your equipped Super:
• Arc: Blinds for ? [1] seconds
• Solar: Applies 15 Scorch (20 with Ember of Ashes)
• Stasis: Applies 30 Slow Stacks for 7 seconds (8 with Whisper of Durance)
• Strand: Severs for 6 seconds (8 with Thread of Continuity)
• Void: Weakens for 4 seconds
src.compendium:
On Kinetic Weapon Kill: 
Enemy explodes in a Super-Matching Explosion that inflicts an Elemental-Matching Debuff.
Grants a stack of Crystalline Transistor for 11 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 stacks.
Loses 1 Crystalline Transistor stack upon expiring, rather than all of them.
Elemental Explosion:
Deals up to 252 [100] Elemental Damage and inflicts an Elemental Debuff based on the equipped Super.
Radius is based on the amount of Crystalline Transistor stacks.
Base = 4 meters | x1 = 6 meters | x2 OR Kinetic Precision Kill = 8 meters. 
Arc: Blind for ? [1] seconds.
Solar: x15+5 Scorch.
Void: Weaken for 4 seconds.
Stasis: x30 Slow for 7+1 seconds.
Strand: Sever for 6+2 seconds.

Damage over time starts at 23 [9] damage, increasing by ~5.5% [?%] per tick.
Enemies breaking free from Suspension take an additional 64 [34?] damage.

src.bungie: Powered melee hits weaken targets. Powered melee final blows create a burst of energy that dramatically weakens nearby targets. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the radius of the burst and the length of the weakening effect.

Does not work with Grapple melee or Song of Flame melees.
Powered Melee damage Weakens targets for 6 seconds (15% debuff).
Powered Melee and Finisher Kills disorient and apply a stronger (30%) Weaken debuff to enemies in a given radius around the target.
The debuff Duration and application radius are dependent on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 15 meter radius, 10 second duration
• Elites, Players: 20m radius, 15s duration
• Minibosses, Bosses: 25m radius, 20s duration
Finishers increase the debuff duration by 5 seconds and the application radius by 5 meters. Both duration and radius are capped at the values provided by killing (Mini)Bosses.
Additional PvP effects of on-kill debuffs: screen is blackened for 7.5 seconds before gradually fading away over the following 7.5 seconds. (HUD remains unobstructed)

Melee Kills and Glaive Melee Kills grant a stack of Warlord's Sigil for 4.75 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
 Finishers grant 3 Warlord's Sigil stacks. Scorch DoT Kills do not grant stacks.
Warlord's Sigil stacks decay one at a time. Finishers refresh the stack duration on animation start.
Warlord's Sigil grants increased Melee Damage per stack.
x1 = 67.5% | x2 = 122% | x3 = 166% | x4 = 202% | x5 = 228%
x6 = 249% | x7 = 265% | x8 = 278% | x9 = 289% | x10 = 300%
Upon reaching or refreshing x10 Warlord's Sigil:
Gain a Melee Ability Charge.
 Grants Warlord's Fury Ready for 8 seconds and cannot be refreshed by Finishers.
Not triggering Warlord's Fury will return the buff to Warlord's Sigil x10.
On Melee/Glaive Melee Usage while Warlord's Fury Ready is active:
400% increased Melee Damage, 0.8x Melee Duration, and 38.4x👀 Melee Regeneration Speed for 10 seconds.
Cannot gain Warlord's Sigil while Warlord's Fury is active. Resets Warlord's Sigil to x0 stacks on buff end.
